record.question: 1.3-kg VLBW infant is on gavage feeding. The nurse notes abdominal distension and increased gastric residuals. What should the nurse do FIRST?
options: Stop feeding and assess for necrotizing enterocolitis
record.explanation: Answer B: Stop feeding and assess for necrotizing enterocolitis. Abdominal distension and increased gastric residuals in a very-low-birth-weight infant raise concern for necrotizing enterocolitis; stop feeds and assess/escalate promptly. Source/context note: Follow neonatal unit protocol; this is an emergency assessment rather than a diagnosis. Reference: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/digestive-diseases/necrotizing-enterocolitis. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
